name: 反応パネルの分類ショートカット
prompt:
Make the second render by tightening only the canvas crop around the existing icon strip. The prior render had the correct nine icons, order, color and icon scale, but excessive blank canvas above and below. Remove that surplus blank area. Output a very short panoramic strip with the exact native 390:62 aspect ratio (about 6.29:1), not a tall screenshot or a broad 2.5:1 image.

The entire 390x62 composition should match the native preview: white canvas, a single pale-mint rounded bar at x16 y8 with width about 358 and height about 43, leaving only about 8px of white space above, 11px below and 16px at the sides. Keep the bar centered vertically. Preserve exactly nine muted-gray thin outline icons at evenly spaced centers x38, 76, 114, 152, 190, 228, 266, 304 and 342: circled info, smile, person, image, star, phone, lock, pushpin, plus. Keep icon scale close to the native 19-21px. Do not redesign the icons, add a selected state, labels, text, emoji grid, search, dividers or more controls.

Use the native preview for the exact strip dimensions, margins and positions. Use v001 only to preserve the icon drawing style. Crop out its empty outer canvas rather than reproducing the whitespace. The original Slack screenshot has a different picker and is not part of this correction. This screen has no text and no hyperlink.
reviewNotes: 第2版を実画像で目視。9つのアウトラインカテゴリの順序と淡いミントバーを保持し、文字・リンクなし。v001からバーはやや大きくなったが、出力キャンバスは1983x793（比率約2.50）のままで、native 390x62（比率約6.29）に合わない。バーは上下に大きな白余白を残し、native y8ではなく約y52から始まり、バー高もnative43pxより約5px大きい。2回の限定試行でも短い横長の切り抜きにはならず、needs-correctionで保存して次IDへ進む。所有者受入・ネイティブ編集・実動作は未検証。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。

inputReferences.role: Primary native preview: exact 390x62 canvas and short-strip geometry
Correction target: LH03-0161 v001; preserve nine icon glyphs while removing oversized white margins
